WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    District,
    "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS literate_nfhs4,
    "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS fullvac_nfhs4,
    "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS literate_nfhs5,
    "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS fullvac_nfhs5
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE State = 'Bihar'
    AND "Survey Round" IN ('NFHS-4', 'NFHS-5')
),
nfhs4 AS (
  SELECT District, fullvac_nfhs4
  FROM base
  WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
),
nfhs5 AS (
  SELECT District, fullvac_nfhs5
  FROM base
  WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
)
SELECT
  nfhs5.District,
  NULLIF(nfhs4.fullvac_nfhs4, 0) AS denominator,
  NULLIF(nfhs5.fullvac_nfhs5, 0) AS numerator,
  (nfhs5.fullvac_nfhs5 - nfhs4.fullvac_nfhs4) AS change_pct
FROM nfhs5
JOIN nfhs4 USING (District)
WHERE nfhs4.fullvac_nfhs4 IS NOT NULL
  AND nfhs5.fullvac_nfhs5 IS NOT NULL;
